snippet.description:
Kisi Se Dil Lagaya Nahi – Aarzoo Khaan | Emotional Hindi Sad Song | New Song 2026 | Arijit Singh Vibe

---

Ab kisi se dil lagaya nahi,
khud ko phir se rulaya nahi…

Bahut kuch seh liya mohabbat mein,
ab kisi ko apna banaya nahi.

Jis dil ne kabhi tumhare liye dhadakna seekha tha,
aaj usne kisi aur ko chahna chhod diya hai.

"Kisi Se Dil Lagaya Nahi"
ek aise insaan ki kahani hai
jo ek baar tootne ke baad
dobara mohabbat karne se darne laga.

Ab na kisi se umeedein hain,
na kisi ke lautne ka intezaar,
bas khud mein simat kar
jee rahe hain hum is baar.

Agar aapne bhi
kisi ko khone ke baad
dobara kisi se dil nahi lagaya,
to ye gaana
aapke dil ko zaroor chhoo jaayega.
